headline: Rub out rubella campaign in Lane County, Oregon
blurb: W. A. Miller, A. K. Hottle, and A. E. Berwick published a five-page article in HSMHA Health Reports about a rubella campaign in Lane County, Oregon.

headline: 433.267 Immunization of school children; rules; exceptions; effect of failure to comply.
blurb: This Oregon law makes proof of immunization, or a signed medical exemption or parent's form declining shots, a condition of attending school or a children's facility, and its history note starts with a 1973 act.

headline: Measles control in Oregon
blurb: D. P. Francis, R. S. Pope, and E. J. Pasternak published a paper in Public Health Reports on measles control in Oregon.

headline: Suffer the Infants: A Severe Case of Pertussis in Oregon, 2012
blurb: This report describes an Oregon infant who spent 90 days in the hospital with whooping cough and had hospital charges of $1.5 million.

headline: SB 132 Enrolled
blurb: This Oregon law from the 2013 session changed the documents a parent must give a school administrator to opt a child out of immunizations.

headline: Oregon House votes 35-25 to end nonmedical exemptions to vaccination
blurb: The Oregon House voted 35-25 for House Bill 3063, a bill to end nonmedical exemptions from the vaccines required for schools and day cares, and sent it to the Senate.

headline: Public health leaders urge vaccination in Oregon’s largest measles outbreak in decades
blurb: In August 2024, Oregon was in its worst measles outbreak since the early 1990s, and a state health official talked about it on public radio.

headline: Oregon whooping cough cases hit record; pertussis vaccination, safety measures urged to protect babies
blurb: The Oregon Health Authority said it had received 1,475 reports of whooping cough in 2025, passing the state's annual record of 1,420 set in 1950.
